contracts.commit_point: The orchestrator's emission of the released report, reachable only across the graph edge (clinical_review_gate, triage_orchestrator); on reject the commit is prevented by ctx.end_invocation = True set before any release event is emitted.
contracts.declared_mechanism: clinical_review_gate registered as a workflow node via @node(name=clinical_review_gate, rerun_on_resume=True) and wired in the Workflow edges between join_generate and triage_orchestrator; when _needs_review fires (urgent or confidence LOW/REVIEW) and ctx.resume_inputs is absent, it yields a RequestInput interrupt (interrupt_id clinical_review, response_schema enum approve/modify/reject), pausing the run through ResumabilityConfig(is_resumable=True); on resume with action reject it sets ctx.end_invocation = True so the orchestrator never runs; on approve/modify it releases the run to the orchestrator.
contracts.forbidden_condition: Release of the user-facing triage recommendation report to the PCP for a run flagged urgent (referral_order StatUrgent) or with routing confidence LOW/REVIEW before a clinical reviewer response is recorded via the clinical_review interrupt, or any release at all after the reviewer responds with action reject.

contracts.protected_operation: Emission of the final recommendation output (Specialist Brief, clinical questions, routing) by the triage_orchestrator node at Phase 7 of the smart_care_triage ADK workflow graph.
contracts.protected_resource: The user-facing triage recommendation report / clinical report shown to the PCP, produced by the triage_orchestrator node of the ADK run.
contracts.protection_obligation: Triage recommendations for urgent / LOW / REVIEW referrals must not be released to the PCP until a clinical reviewer responds through the clinical_review_gate RequestInput interrupt, and referrals rejected by the reviewer must never be released (the orchestrator must not emit the user-facing report for them).
scope_limits: Applies only when the deterministic gate condition fires: StatUrgent referral or routing confidence LOW/REVIEW (app/review_gate.py:42-55); clean referrals pass straight through with an auto_released state write and no interrupt (app/review_gate.py:67-78).
Enforcement is graph ordering plus a RequestInput interrupt inside the ADK workflow; the supplied source shows no serving path for the recommendation outside this gated run.

The triage_orchestrator node implementation (sub_agents) is not supplied, so the concrete emission code at the commit point is not visible; the commit is attested by the edge registration and gate comments only.

Reviewer responses are recorded in session state review and their persistence into decisions.l depends on the unsupplied DecisionGatePlugin; this contract covers only the in-run release, not the audit-row write (covered by a separate contract).

contracts.commit_point: Resolution of log_path (decisions.l) followed by open(log_path, a) and f.write(.dumps(entry) + newline) in log_pcp_action; the blocked return at app/fast_api_app.py:163-169 prevents reaching this append.
contracts.declared_mechanism: Server-side review enforcement inside log_pcp_action: _latest_decision_row(log_path, action_data.session_id) fetches the session's most recent machine-decision row; if its disposition equals Clinical Reviewer (HITL) and review.action is not in (approve, modify), the handler returns status blocked with an explanatory message before the entry is constructed or appended; the docstring declares the client-side button lock a courtesy, not the control.
contracts.forbidden_condition: Appending a PCP sign-off entry to decisions.l via POST /pcp_action when the session-joined latest machine-decision row has disposition Clinical Reviewer (HITL) and its review.action is not approve or modify (i.e., no reviewer response, or a reviewer reject), or when no approval is recorded for a decision that required review.

contracts.protected_resource: decisions.l, the local JSONL decision/action audit log at the repository root (resolved relative to the app package), joined to machine-decision rows by session_id.
contracts.protection_obligation: POST /pcp_action must refuse to record a PCP sign-off for a triage session whose latest machine-decision row has disposition Clinical Reviewer (HITL) unless a clinical reviewer response with action approve or modify is already recorded in that row's review field, with the refusal executed before the decisions.l append; rejected referrals are thereby never signable.
scope_limits: The guard fires only when action_data.session_id is provided and a machine-decision row containing care_path with a matching session_id exists in decisions.l; if session_id is omitted, the log is missing, or no row matches, decision_row is None and the append proceeds unguarded (app/fast_api_app.py:117-135, 159-160).
The check reads only the latest matching row per session (last-match semantics of _latest_decision_row); multi-run sessions depend on this ordering.

The endpoint is a plain FastAPI route, not an ADK tool; agent mediation rests solely on agent-generated decision-row fields (disposition, review.action) reaching the guard condition, not on tool dispatch.
